notes.title: 1.0.0 - stable release
notes.notes:
- fixed the majority of leftover bugs and typos
- dramatically reduced memory and cpu usage by internal engine reworks
- added 20 hand-drawn custom avatars
- added direct access to stash from the shop (Various Assortments)

notes.title: 0.12.0 - custom avatar update
notes.notes:
- added custom avatar selection when starting a new game and in the settings
- dramatically reduced memory usage by internal engine reworks
- minor bug fixes and typo corrections

notes.title: 0.11.0 - autosave update
notes.notes:
- extended auto-saving to dungeon & combat (optional ironman mode in the settings)
- reworked combat target icon that was confusing some players about the attack zone size
- made city facility icons on the city map clickable
- added global volume slider and fixed minor audio bugs
- fixed some dungeon events overlapping issues
- reduced after-combat movement delay
- minor typo corrections

notes.title: 0.8.14 - audio update (CTD fix)
notes.notes: - IMPORTANT - reworked audio code to prevent occasional crashing still present on some devices, caused by certain in-game sounds

notes.title: 0.8.12 - stability update
notes.notes: - fixed various CTD related audio bugs present on some devices

notes.title: 0.8.11 - movement bugfix
notes.notes: - fixed player being stuck when clicking on the inacessible dungeon tile

notes.title: 0.8.10 - feature update
notes.notes:
- added togglable combat log
- added keyboard shortcuts for combat menus (QWEASD)
- fixed some keyboard movement glitches and exploits
- fixed volume slider bug

notes.title: 0.8.9 - stability update
notes.notes: - fixed more audio-related crashing issues on some devices

notes.title: 0.8.8 - stability update
notes.notes: - IMPORTANT - fixed crashing on manifestation encounters present on some devices

notes.title: 0.8.7 - stability update
notes.notes:
- IMPORTANT - fixed crashing on combat start / dungeon exploration related to a buggy audio file
- added WASD / arrow key movement to dungeon
- added ability damage info to enemy bestiary entries
- added resizable window mode (beta)
- reduced floating message duration with fast game speed on

notes.title: Initial Release
notes.notes:
It's not an april's fools joke, Grim Quest is launching today!

A free DEMO is available alongside the full release, and I highly suggest you give it a try to get a taste of the game before deciding if it's something that you would enjoy. Dig in, and please let me know how you feel about it. Happy dungenoneering :)
